venue.value: SC22: International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis (arXiv preprint arXiv:2207.00032)

contribution.value: DeepSpeed Inference is a comprehensive transformer inference system combining inference-optimized GPU kernels (with FP16 and INT8 GeMM), tensor and pipeline parallelism, MoE-specific optimizations, and ZeRO-Inference heterogeneous offloading to deliver up to 7.3x latency reduction and 25x larger servable model size.

ev.section: DeepSpeed Inference: Enabling Efficient Inference of Transformer Models at Unprecedented Scale
ev.quote: DeepSpeed Inference reduces latency by up to 7.3× over the state-of-the-art for latency oriented scenarios and increases throughput by over 1.5x for throughput oriented scenarios. Moreover, it enables trillion parameter scale inference under real-time latency constraints

datasets.value: Synthetic GPT-style prompts (128-token input, 8 generated tokens for dense latency)

ev.quote: we measure the latency of generating 8 tokens with an input prompt of 128 tokens for dense models varying batch sizes

datasets.value: Synthetic MoE prompts (128-token input, 100 generated tokens, batch size 8)

ev.quote: For the sparse MoE model, we measure the per-token latency by generating 100 tokens at a time with a prompt of 128 tokens and batch size 8

datasets.value: Synthetic throughput workload (512-token input, 50 generated tokens)

ev.quote: For throughput oriented applications, we measure the performance with an input prompt of 512 tokens while generating 50 tokens at a time

data_size.value: Synthetic prompts: 128 input tokens for latency benchmarks (8 or 100 generated tokens) and 512 input tokens for throughput (50 generated tokens); no calibration set used
